Regenerate the referenced original duel as a single seamless 5-second continuous shot with a decisive one-person knockdown ending. Match the reference's handsome high-detail painted comic / cel-shaded graphic style, thick precise ink outlines, rich slate-blue corridor floor with brown ochre side edging, strong warm/cool rim lighting, character scale, overhead camera angle, close-up framing and wonderfully detailed long jackets blowing in the wind. Fixed close overhead camera. Two opponents aligned vertically on the center axis, top opponent faces down toward bottom opponent, bottom opponent faces up toward top. This will be center-cropped into a very narrow tall slot-game reel: keep both faces, gun hands and the decisive knockdown centered in the central third of the portrait, while coat tails can flare into the outer thirds. Keep the close-up character scale from the reference, no camera pullback, no distant tiny figures. Identical background throughout. Preserve faces and clothing consistently.
Timeline: first 1 second tense close standoff, wind whipping coat tails; 1-2 seconds quick dramatic revolver exchange with bright brief muzzle flashes; 2-4 seconds ONLY THE SPECIFIED LOSER visibly recoils, gets knocked backward and collapses onto the ground while the winner stays planted upright, gun smoking; last second clearly hold this decided outcome with the loser remaining down and the winner still standing. The visible fall must be smooth and unambiguous, not a freeze or disappearance. No gore. No cut, no black flash, no fade, no transition, no background change, no labels, no text, no camera roll, no added opponents, no dual knockdown, no resurrection.
Top character is the reference's orange/brown leather-coated Hunter with swept dark brown hair, dark face mask and gold/orange revolver. Bottom character is the reference's cyan/teal-coated Outlaw with dark broad-brim cowboy hat and luminous cyan revolver. EXACT OUTCOME: TOP ORANGE HUNTER LOSES. The bottom cyan Outlaw's shot hits top Hunter, who recoils and collapses backward near the top of the frame. Bottom cyan Outlaw stays upright and victorious.
